module: GE extension that feeds the "Occupants" tab of the vehicle configuration screen (pause menu). It lists the seats of the configured vehicle (via gameplay_seatOccupants), the available players (core_multiseat / core_playerPersonas) and lets you seat a player, a dummy or nobody on each seat. The targeted vehicle is the session's (sessionVehicleId) or, failing that, the one resolved by core_vehicle_configTarget. Each change triggers the UI hook VehicleConfigOccupantsStateChanged.
notes: An occupant's weight is seat.weight if present, otherwise defaultWeight = 89 (kg, local value in the file).
Format of the occupant parameter of setSeatOccupant: 'empty', 'dummy' or 'player:<index>' (player index, 0 for the solo player).

During a session, an override is set on the vehicle (setVehicleOccupantsEnabledOverride): occupants stay active if the Occupants tab is open or if enabledWhileConfiguring is true; endSession removes the override.
onVehicleReplaced and onVehicleResetted are simple aliases of onVehicleSpawned.

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded before this one: gameplay_seatOccupants, core_multiseat, core_playerPersonas, core_vehicle_configTarget, core_vehicle_manager.

onVehicleReplaced.desc: Alias of onVehicleSpawned: reapplies the override and notifies the UI if the replaced vehicle is the session's.

onVehicleResetted.desc: Alias of onVehicleSpawned: same behavior after a vehicle reset.

getState.desc: Returns the state displayed by the tab: vehicle id, seats, players, multi-seat mode, installed part paths (partPath), and enabledWhileConfiguring. If no valid vehicle is targeted, returns {vehicleId=nil, seats={}, players={}}.

returns.desc: {vehicleId, seats, players, multiseatActive, vehiclePartPaths, enabledWhileConfiguring}. players: sorted list of {id, label, color '#RRGGBB', icon}.

beginSession.desc: Starts a configuration session on the targeted vehicle. Removes the override from the old vehicle if it changed, stores the new one and applies the occupants override.

enabled.desc: false to disable occupants during configuration; any other value (including nil) enables them.

endSession.desc: Ends the session: removes the occupants override on the session vehicle and resets the local state (sessionVehicleId, active tab).

setEnabledWhileConfiguring.desc: Enables or disables occupants during configuration and reapplies the override.

setOccupantTabActive.desc: Indicates whether the Occupants tab is displayed; as long as it is, occupants stay active even if enabledWhileConfiguring is false.

active.desc: true if the tab is open.

setSeatOccupant.desc: Sets a seat's occupant: empty, dummy or player. Frees the seat if needed before reoccupying it, then notifies the UI.

returns.desc: {success=boolean, reason=string|nil}. Reasons: seatMissing, invalidOccupant, enterFailed, occupied, or the reason returned by setDummyOccupant.

unseatAll.desc: Empties all seats of the targeted vehicle and notifies the UI.

returns.desc: false if no vehicle is targeted, otherwise true.

fillEmptySeatsWithDummies.desc: Places an 89 kg dummy on each free seat of the targeted vehicle.

returns.desc: Number of dummies added (0 if no vehicle).

removeAllDummies.desc: Removes all dummies from the targeted vehicle.

returns.desc: Number removed, as returned by gameplay_seatOccupants.clearDummyOccupants (0 if no vehicle).

onSeatOccupantEnter.desc: Hook called when an occupant sits down; notifies the UI if it is the session vehicle.

onSeatOccupantExit.desc: Hook called when an occupant leaves a seat; notifies the UI if it is the session vehicle.

onLocalParticipantsChanged.desc: Hook called when the list of local participants (multi-seat) changes; notifies the UI if a session is in progress.

onVehicleSpawned.desc: Hook called when a vehicle spawns; if it is the session's, reapplies the override and notifies the UI.

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is destroyed; if it is the session's, forgets the session and notifies the UI.

onVehicleConfigTargetChanged.desc: Hook called when the configuration target changes: removes the override from the old vehicle, switches to the new one and notifies the UI.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook called when the extension is unloaded; calls endSession.
